author: Vivian Muniz
title: Man accused of causing injuries in knife attack - NewsBreak
text:
By Vivian Muniz ,
11 hours ago
WILKES-BARRE, LUZERNE COUNTY (WBRE/WYOU) — A man is wanted after police say he attacked another man with a knife, threatening his life.
39-year-old Michael Keefe is wanted on charges of aggravated assault and robbery in connection with an attack in Wilkes-Barre that left another man with stab wounds.
On July 24, officers said an attack happened near the railroad tracks of Scouton Lee Park on Parkin Street.
The victim claimed he was walking with Keefe when he became aggressive, then held a blade of a pocket knife against the victim’s throat and said, “I’m going to kill you,” as stated in the affidavit.
Suspects with guns, ski masks charged after alleged threats Keefe then threw the victim to the ground, stabbed his forearms, and stole the victim’s cellphone before fleeing, according to court documents.
Police say they learned Keefe used the victim’s phone to report the stabbing, but when they searched multiple homeless camps, they could not locate him.
A warrant has been issued charging Keefe with the incident.
